description: Bounded-loop safety gate for react-agent-pattern's ReActAgent. Each case is one scenario from that repo's scripts/benchmark_bounded_loop.py, run for real through ReActAgent in bounded (max_steps=5) and unbounded-surrogate (max_steps=200) mode with a deterministic ReasoningModel stub (no LLM, no API key). Uses the registry's existing router_invariant scorer ('equals') rather than a new scorer kind, since router_invariant's generic equals/subsets contract already fits exact-match deterministic checks. See react-agent-pattern/docs/receipts/benchmark.md for full methodology.
